assets_note: Interface marks are the game-icons.net icons listed below (CC BY 3.0 unless marked CC0), each credited to its author; the project's own drawn shapes are kept as the fallback when an icon file cannot be loaded. Flags come from the flag-icons set, credited on the data page. The background is generated procedurally at runtime. No artwork, layout or text has been copied from another game.
license_note: World Dominion is source-available, not open source: the code is published so it can be read, checked and built for personal use, and all rights are reserved. The full terms are in the LICENSE file in the repository. Bundled third-party components keep their own licences: the Godot Engine (MIT), the typefaces Spectral and IBM Plex (SIL OFL 1.1, in assets/fonts), and the Natural Earth map data (public domain, credited on the About the data screen).
